extends "res://tests/run_tests.gd"
## Mid-prologue save (opening done, rag taken, one wipe), written by the game, then turned into the version-1 (第②步)
## layout: the step-2 schema is the current one without the "step3" section.
func _run() -> void:
	await frames(3)
	root.remove_child(main)
	var s = load("res://tests/sample_suite.gd").new(self)
	SaveGame.erase()
	await s.new_game()
	await s.finish_scene()
	var it = s.g.interiors
	await s.stand_near(it.anchor("dorm_main", "rag"), [Vector2(0, 18), Vector2(18, 0), Vector2(-18, 0), Vector2(0, -18)])
	await tap(KEY_E)
	await s.finish_scene()
	await s.stand_near(it.anchor("dorm_main", "puddle"), [Vector2(0, 26), Vector2(26, 0), Vector2(-26, 0), Vector2(0, -26)])
	await tap(KEY_E)
	await frames(30)
	s.smp.save_now("fixture")
	var doc = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SaveGame.path()))
	doc["version"] = 1
	doc["state"].erase("step3")
	var f := FileAccess.open(OS.get_environment("FIXTURE_OUT"), FileAccess.WRITE)
	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(doc, "", true, true))
	f.close()
	print("MID unlocked ", doc["state"]["sample"]["unlocked"], " stage ", doc["state"]["story"]["stage"])
	SaveGame.erase()
	quit(0)
